data.long_meaning: To honor God, from the Greek name Theophilos, meaning 'lover of God'. The name Timoteo carries the meaning “Honor to God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Timoteo usually hope their child will grow to embody honor to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: טימותאו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טימותאו הוא שם שמקורו מיוונית ומשמעותו 'מכובד על ידי אלוהים' או 'מיקרואו', שילוב של המילים 'טימו' שפירושו כבוד ו'תאוס' שפירושו אלוהים. השם טימותאו מוזכר בברית החדשה, וטימותי היה תלמידו של פאולוס ושימש כשותף וכמיסיונר במסעותיו של פאולוס.

in_greek.name: Τιμόθεος
in_greek.long_meaning: Τιμόθεος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'τιμή' που σημαίνει τιμή και 'θεός' που σημαίνει θεός. Ο Τιμόθεος ήταν ένας από τους πρώτους χριστιανούς και μαθητές του Αποστόλου Παύλου, στον οποίο έγραψε δύο επιστολές που περιλαμβάνονται στην Καινή Διαθήκη.

in_latin.name: Timotheus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Timotheus is derived from the Greek words 'timē' meaning honor and 'theos' meaning God. In the early Christian church, Timotheus was a companion and disciple of Saint Paul, to whom he addressed two epistles in the New Testament.

in_english.name: Timoteo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Timoteo originates from the Greek name Τιμόθεος (Timótheos), meaning 'honoring God' or 'God-fearing'. It is derived from the words 'timē', meaning honor, and 'theos', meaning God. In the New Testament, Timothy was a companion and disciple of Saint Paul, to whom he addressed two epistles. The name Timoteo has been used across Christian cultures, symbolizing devotion, reverence, and spiritual dedication.

data.cultural_impact: The name Timoteo became popular among early Christians due to its Greek root, 'Theophilos', which signified a deep love for God, reflecting the values and aspirations of the emerging Christian faith during that time.
data.spiritual_significance: Timoteo embodies the spiritual commitment and dedication to one's faith. The name is a constant reminder to the bearer of the importance of having a strong relationship with God and to love Him above all else. The name remains a source of inspiration for those seeking to deepen their faith and foster a greater love and connection with the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Timoteo, from the Greek name Timotheos, means "honoring God" or "God's gift." It is a name deeply rooted in faith, signifying dedication to the divine and a sense of being blessed by God's grace.
